fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-sentence summary of what this file does.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Programming language (typescript, python, rust, go, etc.).

fields.name: has_tests
fields.description: True if this file contains test cases (it test, describe, pytest functions, #[test], etc.).

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Up to 5 concrete code-quality issues (anti-patterns, bugs, smells). Each item is a short phrase, not a sentence.

fields.name: external_deps
fields.description: Up to 10 names of imported / required external packages (skip stdlib).
